name: cs-navigator
description: CS Navigator routes explicit capability-selection requests to bundled first-party skills while keeping ordinary tasks native and preserving evidence boundaries.

interface.longDescription: CS Navigator 0.9.4 helps users decide when to stay with native ChatGPT and when to use a bundled CS workflow. It routes explicit capability-selection requests across writing, research, Brazilian context, academic review, design, engineering, visual preservation, project continuity and founder/product strategy. Evidence states and limitations remain explicit, and ordinary tasks stay native when an additional workflow adds no material value.
defaultPrompt: Help me decide whether this task should stay native or use a CS Navigator skill.
Use CS Navigator to choose the smallest useful workflow for this task.
Show the evidence boundary and unknowns before recommending a CS capability.
